description.p: Griffel is a distraction-free Markdown editor for the Linux desktop. Text lives in a centered column while the interface fades away as you write, and returns when you need it.

ul.li: In-place Markdown highlighting while the source stays unchanged
Live preview powered by Pandoc, beside, below, or in its own window
Focus Mode dims everything but the current sentence
Hemingway Mode keeps you moving forward by blocking deletions
Peek popovers for formulas, images, links, footnotes and word definitions
Statistics, search and replace, snapshots, and export to PDF, HTML, ODT and more

description.p: First public beta: editing, in-place highlighting, live preview, Focus and Hemingway modes, spell checking, peek popovers, export, snapshots and recovery, autosave, and adaptive dark, sepia and light appearances.
